build_slowfast_model: build a SlowFast dual-pathway video recognition model from config with slow and fast pathways
build_resnet_model: build a single-pathway ResNet video model backbone with configurable depth and temporal kernels
build_x3d_model: build an X3D efficient video recognition model with width and depth scaling factors
build_mvit_model: build a Multiscale Vision Transformer model with optional online memory and causal attention
fuse_fast_to_slow: fuse Fast pathway features into the Slow pathway using a 3D convolution and batch norm
